kind_note: agent harness: open-source terminal coding agent written in Rust, Apache-2.0, at github.com/Zfinix/aster, described on its repo as "An open-source agent harness for software work."
note: Lab correction: no lab is named. The project is maintained under the GitHub account Zfinix (an individual maintainer, not a lab). Sources checked: https://github.com/Zfinix/aster (no first-release or launch date on the page) and https://github.com/Zfinix/aster/releases. The releases page shows only the 10 most recent releases. The oldest one shown is cli-v0.5.0, dated "05 Sep" with no year in the header; the cli-v0.7.1 asset timestamps read 2026-10-05, which suggests 2026. That is the earliest release I could see, not confirmed as the first. Earlier releases would be on page 2, which I did not open. Other dated items are not a first release: the Zed editor extension PR (https://github.com/zed-industries/extensions/pull/7494) registers version 0.1.0 around 2026-09-05, which is a pull request date. Excluded as different products named Aster: SK Telecom's consumer personal agent 'aster' (asterapp.ai; pre-launch announcements from 2024-2025), AsterWise's Aster (a model-routing platform), astercloud/aster (a Go agent framework), mgilbir/aster (a Go Vega charts library), and the aster-core crate. itsbrex/aster is a fork of Zfinix/aster. To settle the date, sort the Zfinix/aster releases or tags by oldest, or check the commit history for the first commit.
